content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software without relying on PayPal or Stripe requires an alternative payment infrastructure. This infrastructure is built around the concept of 'sovereignty' – where the customer, not the platform, owns their digital commerce stack. At its core, this approach provides digital creators with a secure, decentralized, and cost-effective way to sell their digital assets without the risk of platform fees, restrictions, or shutdowns.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this payment infrastructure is based on a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. At the core of this setup is NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway that enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a mere 0.5% fee. This is significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad on every sale. To illustrate this, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference can amount to $921 in retained revenue. Additionally, Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages provide a free hosting solution for digital products, while Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle backend logic and order storage. Supabase and Google Sheets serve as a free data storage solution, and Cloudflare R2 and Google Drive provide instant file delivery. This setup ensures that digital creators can focus on creating and selling their products without worrying about infrastructure costs or limitations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who want to sell their products without relying on conventional payment platforms. Whether you're an ebook author, a course creator, or a template designer, this setup provides you with the tools and resources you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With Complete Builder Kit, you can get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, worth $348 separately, for just $197. This comprehensive package includes everything you need to start selling your digital products with confidence.
Using NOWPayments can retain up to $921 in revenue per month compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this payment infrastructure include NOWPayments, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, Supabase, Google Sheets, Cloudflare R2, and Google Drive. Each component plays a crucial role in ensuring that digital products are delivered securely and efficiently to customers. By integrating these components, digital creators can create a seamless and automated payment experience for their customers, eliminating the need for manual processing and reducing the risk of errors or disputes.

What is the difference between using a conventional payment platform like PayPal or Stripe and using an alternative payment infrastructure like NOWPayments?

Using a conventional payment platform like PayPal or Stripe can result in high fees, restrictions, and shutdowns, whereas an alternative payment infrastructure like NOWPayments provides a secure, decentralized, and cost-effective way to sell digital products without relying on these platforms.
